item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
First of all, this is a good turn from the last chapter, so good. We get plot advancement.

However, one thing I notice about your style that like… it's not a big deal but it throws me for a loop. You do this thing where you have moments that occur in the moment pop up in the narration, which is cool and lends depth to the voice, but they all feel off because it's told in past tense. It just feels a little jarring to have obviously present tense thoughts repeated in the past tense. I personally think this could have been rewritten in present tense and that would've helped a lot. Also gives you a bit more of a feeling of discovery as you go through with the character.

Wondertainment has always made me think of the toy factory in "Toys"

DarkStuff, I was expecting it to be as cute as a candy-coated rainbow striped razor blade. And it was!

Wondertainment has always made me think of the toy factory in "Toys", that strangely flawed movie. Except that the hidden vein of dark madness is significantly more visible and frequently better written.

item.content:encoded: I am so so sorry for everyone who thought it was just going to be cute. I'm not saying that sarcastically either, as soon as I saw all the comments with "this is adorable", I suddenly felt really bad with where I was going with it. 'Cause maybe this site just needs more cute things, you know? Maybe I'll write more cute Wondertainment at a later date. Anyways, yeah, this was fun to write. I liked world building with my version of Wondertainment.
